scope: Three synthetic geometric specifications, not broad accuracy benchmark

cases.prompt: a rectangular solid box exactly 40 mm long, 30 mm wide and 8 mm high, centered at the origin. No holes. Output only OpenSCAD code.
a rectangular plate exactly 40 mm long, 30 mm wide and 8 mm thick, centered at the origin, with one 10 mm diameter cylindrical through-hole along Z at the center. Output only OpenSCAD code.
a cylindrical spacer exactly 12 mm high, 20 mm outer diameter and one concentric 6 mm diameter through-hole. Cylinder axis Z. Output only OpenSCAD code.

prompt_assembly: For create-me-a prefix remove the case leading indefinite article; baseline preserves original MakeMe prompt
acceptance: Unchanged original bounding-box/volume 1%, requested centering 0.001 mm, bore point probes and closed STL
rules: Preserve all millimeter sizes exactly. Use d for a stated diameter, not r. Use difference to subtract through-holes. Use center=true on all axes when centered at the origin is requested. Return only OpenSCAD code.
limits: Two seeds for sampled setting; no statistical reliability claim
No human changes to generated code
These variants are exploratory and evaluated on the same cases
Loading and file-cache state are not controlled performance variables
